items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: he organized a group with the Palmer Brothers and myself -- I was the piano player.

ctx.x: Oh, he sang. He sang with Luis Russell later on.

Yeah, possibly. Our big number was 'Trouble In Paradise' over the Amalgamated Radio! As a matter of fact, that's the second time... I don't know if it was before... Was it before...? I was playing with the Palmer Brothers. When John Kirby left Fletcher's band, he organized a group with the Palmer Brothers and myself -- I was the piano player. We tried going around different places. And we broadcasted over the Amalgamated... See, WEAF, they had a feud or something with NB...I don't know if it was National Biscuit…
